title: Ice Flame, a Grade Nine Weapon Core and the Beast Spirit Furnace
summary: Xu Liguo turns on the unconscious Wang Lin, but finds that Wang Lin left a strand of consciousness in him and backs down at once. Since his body cannot bear the cold of the merging pills, Wang Lin decides to make it completely cold and moves deep into the fourteenth valley to cultivate. Over three years the fire-beast crisis in Huo Fen is ended by a rank four cultivation country, and the war with Xuan Wu settles into a truce. His core embryo forms and an ice flame appears in him. From the spirit-beast skulls buried under the valley he refines a rare grade nine weapon core to upgrade his flying sword. He then goes to Nan Dou City, one of the 998 cities of the Sea of Devils, and trades a jiao skin at the Refining Pavilion for the grade five Hundred Beast Spirit Furnace, which the Fighting Evil Sect had reserved but never paid for. Three Core Formation cultivators chase him out of the city to take it.

cultivation: After three years Wang Lin's core embryo is complete and only the final push to Core Formation is left. The Refining Pavilion clerk reads him as Foundation Establishment great perfection.
